existingKnowledgeElsewhere.scope: Insulation, shock and leakage already taught in shared theory; no full electrical tooling lesson needed in field practical.
Earthing versus lightning protection already taught, without claiming every protection product is interchangeable.
Pipe system, sleeve, supports and separate tests already taught in shared theory.
Oxygen deficiency, H2S, dust and distinct worker/supervisor education already taught in theory.
Sorting and housekeeping objectives already taught in shared theory.
Maintained cleanliness and3S/4S/5Sterminology already taught; no duplicate practical session.

fullLessonImportDecision: No new whole-lesson assignment in this pass; selected comparator contexts do not certify absence of every transferable atom.

freshPrimaryReference.title: Chiba Labour Bureau2026 confirmed occupational accident report
freshPrimaryReference.scope: Accident-type descriptions, not new incidence statistics, all classification codes, rescue or treatment procedures. Source table visually inspected.

remainingSourceObjectives: Reverse source-to-app objectives, including named subtypes, numbers and conditions, require explicit per-atom decisions; four concepts per lesson are not an exhaustive denominator.
Source equipment photographs and caption details still require a separate recognition/artwork map; source figures are not copied into the application.
No independent domain/native/rights approval or production Expo/native-device validation follows from these records.
